description: Registers one or more DXP MatchMaker answers inferred from the user's natural-language response ('CMS' is treated as a synonym for 'DXP')

inferredAnswers.description: Answers inferred from the user's natural-language response. Each item must include the questionnaire questionId, one or more selected answerIds, optional confidence from 0 to 1, and optional evidence text.

sessionId.description: The sessionId from the current chat context

name: register_dxp_inferred_answers
